races.display_title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Making his third start back this season, EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY ran well when second at Punchestown and he can build on that effort to go one better from what remains a handy mark. Heading the list of dangers is Mickey Cohen who arrives on the back of a win over hurdles, while Mistyburn and Knocknagoran Lady could also be in the mix. EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY (IRE) MICKEY COHEN (IRE) MISTYBURN (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Ceroc (3/1), Mistyburn (5/1), Mickey Cohen (5/1), Chanceitlucky (6/1), Everystep Oftheway (8/1), Smallcraftwarning (8/1), Littlebiggie (10/1), Knocknagoran Lady (14/1), Heroes Of Renown (16/1), Giant Haystacks (16/1), Dorans Law (16/1), Born Bright (25/1), Malton Groove (33/1), Orkneys Jack (33/1)

races.verdict: It was encouraging COOLTOBECARELESS backed up his impressive Chepstow win with a solid third in a Grade 2 at Cheltenham just 2 weeks later and, with that form proving strong, he looks more than up to defying a penalty back in lesser company. Stars Aligning and Louxor de Grugy have both shown promise in bumpers and their pedigrees point to them doing even better over hurdles, while Keeptheflagflying is also of interest on his Rules debut. COOLTOBECARELESS (IRE) STARS ALIGNING LOUXOR DE GRUGY (FR)

races.display_title: PricedUp Bet Handicap Chase
races.verdict: JUKEBOX D'EDDY was in top form when last seen in the spring and having gone well fresh before, Tom Gretton's 7-y-o gets the nod to pick up from where he left off. Jimmyjeroo was a bit laboured at Huntingdon last month but should reapplied cheekpieces spark him back to life, he's put forward as the main threat from a reduced mark. Glengolly and Brother Boris can fight out third. JUKEBOX D'EDDY (FR) JIMMYJEROO GLENGOLLY
races.betting_forecast: Jukebox D'eddy (9/4), Felton Bellevue (3/1), Subtle Fortune (11/2), Brother Boris (13/2), Glengolly (13/2), El Muchacho (10/1), Deadly Missile (20/1), Jimmyjeroo (20/1), Jo Lescribaa (50/1), Kadex (50/1)

races.display_title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict: BY JOVE GRACE showed improved form when a clear-cut winner of a Musselburgh maiden in September and, having not been seen to best effect on nursery debut last time, she is taken to double her tally. Dowman is feared most as he bids for a quick-fire hat-trick, ahead of Harry's Pop . BY JOVE GRACE (IRE) DOWMAN (IRE) HARRY'S POP
